scheme_name: National Award For Senior Citizens (Vayoshreshtha Samman): Best Public Sector Organisation In Promoting The Wellbeing And Welfare Of Senior Citizens
other_conditions: Nominee must be a public sector undertaking that has formulated post‑retirement career policies for its employees, created geriatric medical care infrastructure or similar initiatives, arranged for healthy and productive ageing of its employees, and provided barrier‑free facilities for senior citizens at the workplace.
Nominations must be made by authorized agencies or individuals; self‑nominations are not considered.
The nominee must be recommended in writing by an authorized recommender.
The awards are open to all Indian institutions, organizations and individuals without discrimination on the grounds of religion, race, sex, caste or creed.
benefits_summary: Awardees receive a citation, memento, cash award and the Government covers travel, lodging and related expenses for the award ceremony.
